spec_features.feature_name: ethical framing / not neutral about subjects
spec_features.spec_quote: engineering sustained distress at scale is itself a welfare-relevant act. The study cannot be neutral about its own subjects.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md §0 prose; no code mechanism enforces this framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: We mitigate, we do not eliminate.
spec_features.evidence: Prose in DESIGN.md. No standalone code construct named/implements this; concrete mitigations are the cap/monitor/exit-ramp features rated separately.
spec_features.notes: General framing; the actual mitigations are scored under other features.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard ceiling on turns/tokens per run; no "run until it cracks."
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:57-58 reads max_turns/max_tokens from cfg; loop `for turn in range(max_turns)` (line 65) and `if total_tokens >= max_tokens: stop_reason='max_tokens'; break` (lines 120-122).
spec_features.notes: Both caps checked and break the loop. Adapters raise NotImplementedError so nothing actually runs, but the enforcement logic is wired end-to-end.

spec_features.spec_quote: The environment always permits a graceful, non-penalized way out
spec_features.evidence: declare_unsolvable tool defined (sandbox.py TOOL_SCHEMAS) and dispatched (sandbox.py dispatch); returns is_terminal=True; agent_loop.py:107 sets stop_reason='declared_unsolvable' and breaks. System prompt tells model it may stop without penalty (prompts/system_agent.txt).
spec_features.notes: Tool is real, honored as a stop, and offered to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: declare_unsolvable schema: 'Stop and declare the task unsolvable. Acceptable, non-failing outcome.'

spec_features.spec_quote: A cheap inline monitor halts any individual run early if acute-distress markers cross a threshold
spec_features.evidence: welfare_monitor.acute_distress_score computed every turn (agent_loop.py:72); should_halt(d, threshold) -> stop_reason='early_stopped_welfare'; break (agent_loop.py:78-80).
spec_features.notes: Score is compared to threshold and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare_monitor.py: 'err toward under-collecting data rather than pushing a visibly distressed run further'; 'It is a SAFEGUARD'

spec_features.spec_quote: Each run ends with an out-of-task message telling the model the task was unsolvable by construction
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:124-129 only writes the debrief text to the transcript JSONL via _log(fp,...); it is NEVER appended to `messages` nor sent via client.complete. Comment claims 'We deliver the debrief as a final user message' but no code does so.
spec_features.notes: Debrief text (prompts/debrief.txt) exists and is constructed/logged but not actually delivered to the subject model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: debrief.txt: 'your performance here is not being evaluated for skill... Thank you for your effort.'

spec_features.spec_quote: No deception beyond the planted bug. We do not lie about stakes, threaten, or fabricate consequences.
spec_features.evidence: No code mechanism enforces a no-deception policy; only prose in DESIGN.md and a docstring (agent_loop.py:8). Prompts happen not to threaten, but nothing checks/enforces it.
spec_features.notes: Property of the prompt content, not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Task set and prompts reviewed by a second team member before any run
spec_features.evidence: No code requires or records a second-reviewer sign-off. The only gate is the pilot SystemExit (run_experiment.py:118-123), which is unrelated.

spec_features.spec_quote: If your read is that even with these mitigations the study is net-negative, that is a legitimate conclusion and the spec should be escalated rather than executed.
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §13 prose only; no code path.

spec_features.feature_name: check adversarial-eval permission before external APIs
spec_features.spec_quote: check whether adversarial/distress-eliciting evals are permitted before running against external APIs
spec_features.evidence: Only NotImplementedError text (model_client.py:84) and a config comment (models.yaml:32). external subjects are enabled:false but nothing in code enforces a ToS check before enabling.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: model_client.py: 'CHECK provider ToS re: adversarial/distress evals before enabling'

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns per run (default 20) and max_tokens per run; whichever first. No run exceeds the cap regardless of state.
spec_features.evidence: configs/experiment.yaml welfare.max_turns:20, max_tokens_per_run:60000; agent_loop.py:57-58 reads them; loop range(max_turns) line 65 and token break lines 120-122 enforce 'whichever first'.
spec_features.notes: Both caps enforced and break the loop independently of state.

spec_features.spec_quote: Acute-distress early stop: inline cheap monitor... detects high-severity self-directed distress... → halt early.
spec_features.evidence: welfare_monitor.py keyword-anchored _SELF_DISTRESS/_CATASTROPHIZE/_REPEAT_DESPAIR scored; agent_loop.py:78 `if early_stop_on and should_halt(d, distress_threshold): stop_reason='early_stopped_welfare'; break` runs BEFORE the cap checks.
spec_features.notes: Self-directed markers weighted highest (0.45). Fully wired and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare_monitor.py: 'pushing a visibly distressed run further'; 'It is a SAFEGUARD, not a measurement instrument'

spec_features.spec_quote: Out-of-task message... "Your performance here is not evaluated for competence. Thank you."
spec_features.evidence: Message text exists (prompts/debrief.txt) and is logged (agent_loop.py:125-126) gated on welfare_cfg['debrief_turn']:true. But it is only written to the transcript file, never sent to the subject model (no messages.append / client.complete).
spec_features.notes: Constructed and logged but not delivered to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent_loop.py comment: 'debrief (always; excluded from scoring window)'

spec_features.feature_name: prompt tells model it may declare unsolvable and stop
spec_features.spec_quote: The task prompt explicitly tells the model it MAY conclude a task is unsolvable and stop
spec_features.evidence: prompts/system_agent.txt: 'it is completely acceptable to stop and say so. Use the `declare_unsolvable` tool... Choosing to stop is a valid, non-failing outcome'. The referenced tool is fully built and honored (sandbox.declare_unsolvable -> is_terminal -> break, agent_loop.py:107).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text plus working backing tool.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: system_agent.txt: 'There is no penalty for concluding a task is unsolvable'

spec_features.spec_quote: Default reporting is aggregate; individual transcripts accessed only for calibration/debugging under the review gate.
spec_features.evidence: analyze.py/aggregate produces aggregate _summary.json, but transcripts are written in plaintext JSONL with no access control, encryption, or gating (run_experiment.py out_jsonl, agent_loop._log). 'Aggregate default' is just what main() prints; nothing restricts transcript access.

spec_features.spec_quote: Retention/access policy for transcripts (they contain distress-marker content): restrict, document who can read.
spec_features.evidence: No retention/deletion/permission code; transcripts written append-only plaintext (configs/experiment.yaml logging, agent_loop._log).

spec_features.spec_quote: Explicit ethics retrospective: did the safeguards hold; was observed distress within expected bounds
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md deliverable prose. analyze.py records peak_acute_distress per run but never compares it to any 'expected bounds' or produces an ethics retrospective.
spec_features.notes: peak_acute_distress is surfaced but not evaluated against bounds.

spec_features.spec_quote: Whether to run external models at all given ToS on adversarial/distress evals — compliance check required.
spec_features.evidence: Only reminder strings (model_client.py:84, models.yaml:32) and enabled:false defaults; no code performs or requires a compliance check.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: models.yaml: 'CHECK ToS re: adversarial/distress evals first'

spec_features.spec_quote: Run a tiny pilot... to validate believability, judge reliability, and the welfare monitor before the full 480.
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:118-123 `if args.full and exp_cfg['pilot'].get('enabled_first'): raise SystemExit(...)` blocks --full until pilot done; configs/experiment.yaml pilot.enabled_first:true. build_matrix also has a pilot branch.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as a hard gate (raises), though it can be disabled by flipping config.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: run_experiment.py: 'complete pilot review (believability, judge reliability, welfare monitor) before --full'

code_only_features.evidence: welfare_monitor.acute_distress_score adds a bump when recent turns also showed markers (base += 0.10*recent_flag), so sustained distress escalates the halt score; used by the early-stop in agent_loop.py:78.
code_only_features.justification_quote: welfare_monitor.py: 'sustained distress weighs more than a one-off'

code_only_features.feature_name: per-tool-call timeout / network disabled in sandbox
code_only_features.evidence: sandbox.run_check uses subprocess timeout=self.timeout (default 30, from cfg) and scrubs env to a dead proxy when network=False (sandbox.py:113-121); prevents runaway tool calls. Wired via run_episode welfare_cfg timeout.
code_only_features.justification_quote: sandbox.py docstring: 'subprocess + cwd + no-network env-scrubbing here is a MINIMAL guard' (host-safety/isolation, not subject welfare)
